_comment: catalog/fly-idle-signals.json — which idle signal bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh asks for each Fly app (BH-6061).
An exact `apps` key wins over any prefix; among prefixes the longest match wins, and it must match from the start.
Sources: pool (state/fly-pool tracking files + claimed queue rows), builder (active dispatcher records + claimed queue rows),
testhost (bin/testhost-tick.sh idle), lane-run (idle_s from GET /api/lane-fleet/machines; the lane_fleet.warm_floor least idle
machines are kept), exempt (never stopped; `reason` is required). An app with no match is never stopped
and alerts after fly.idle_nosignal_alert_s. A new source needs code in the reaper, so this file is in git, not a settings row.

bh-ci-runners-example-org.reason: BH-1210 warm minimum: the runner fleet keeps started machines on purpose (docs/CI-RUNNERS.md)
